context.transcript:
Thanks for coming out to look at my roof. I got a little
salary increase at my job recently, and I figured it was
time to finally get this work done.
Yes, it's best to replace roofing before you start to have
big problems like leaks.
So, when would your crew be able to begin?
Around the end of the month. But you'll need to
select a material. Here's a brochure that shows the
materials we work with. You have asphalt now, but
you could consider other options.
I'm up for a change. I like the look of this one-| like
that it doesn't require much maintenance and comes in
a lot of colors.
context.transcript_translation:
谢谢你过来查看我的屋顶。我最近工作加了一点薪，所以觉得终于该把这项工程做了。
是的，最好在开始出现漏水之类的大问题之前更换屋面。
那么，你们的施工队什么时候可以开工？
大约这个月底。不过你需要选择一种材料。这本宣传册介绍了我们使用的材料。你现在用的是沥青，不过也可以考虑其他选择。
我愿意换一种。我喜欢这种的外观——它不太需要维护，而且有很多颜色可选。
